parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(clave,valor),'{}'::jsonb) AS config, $1::jsonb AS entrada FROM pf_config

INSERT INTO pf_registro(clave,tipo,estado,ejecucion,documento) SELECT $1,'migracion','reservado',$2, CASE WHEN $4='' THEN $3::jsonb ELSE $3::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('ruta','/api/apartados/'||(a.documento->'resultado'->>'id')||'/abonos') END FROM (SELECT 1) AS uno LEFT JOIN pf_registro a ON a.clave=$4 AND a.estado='confirmado' WHERE $4='' OR a.clave IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING clave,documento

UPDATE pf_registro SET estado='confirmado', actualizado=now(), documento=documento||jsonb_build_object('resultado',$3::jsonb) WHERE clave=$1 AND ejecucion=$2 AND estado='reservado' RETURNING clave,estado
UPDATE pf_registro SET estado='revision', actualizado=now(), documento=documento||jsonb_build_object('error',$3::text) WHERE clave=$1 AND ejecucion=$2 AND estado='reservado' RETURNING clave,estado

SELECT p.clave, coalesce(r.estado,'sin_reservar') AS estado, coalesce(r.ejecucion=$2,false) AS en_esta_ejecucion, r.documento->>'error' AS error FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(clave,n) LEFT JOIN pf_registro r USING (clave) ORDER BY n
